protocol.task: retrospective same-hour traffic estimation using observed weather; not advance forecasting
protocol.training: all retained timestamps strictly before each origin; fresh pipeline per fold and policy
protocol.weather_row_semantics: first or last valid-temperature source row per timestamp; require target agreement
protocol.timestamp_semantics: naive whole-hour source clock; no timezone/DST inference or gap filling
protocol.seasonal_lag: exact same-clock-time seven calendar days earlier from training only
protocol.seasonal_fallback: training weekday/hour mean, then training global mean
protocol.pooling: every retained 2017 timestamp once; pool residuals, not fold metrics
protocol.temporal_cohorts: fixed calendar quarters of 2017, descriptive only
protocol.paired_mae_sign: random_forest minus baseline on the same observations
protocol.sensitivity_sign: last minus first on the same observations; no policy selection
protocol.limitations: development year, not untouched test data; first/last are alternatives, not exhaustive bounds; operational feature/label latency unknown; no significance claim
